target.title: feat(review): add offline local-range review
target.body:
Supersedes #369 after the contributor fork rejected the maintainer rewrite. This keeps Cameron's implementation and co-author credit, rebased and hardened against current `main`.

## What changed

- Adds `review --local-range` for a full proof-aware review of `merge-base(<base>, HEAD)..HEAD` before a PR exists.
- Defaults to the checkout where the command is invoked; `--target-dir` remains available.
- Requires a clean committed range and rejects incompatible item-number flags.
- Withholds GitHub credentials, isolates cached `gh` auth, disables web search, and skips host URL/media preprocessing. The Codex model call is still networked, so this is not described as air-gapped.
- Stores default run artifacts under `.git/clawsweeper/reviews/local-range-<time>-<pid>/`, keeping the target worktree clean.
- Documents `--body-file`, `--additional-policy`, and the local-range workflow.

## Proof

Exact head: `314f66448ece66d86f9ebea5f8185fdc7912c8db`

- `pnpm run check`: 614 unit tests and 617 repair tests passed.
- Changed coverage: 100% lines, 89.17% branches, 100% functions.
- Overall coverage: 76.84% lines, 70.82% branches, 84.13% functions.
- Focused local-range suite: 10/10 passed, including current-checkout default, git-private artifacts, empty `gh` config, and clean worktree preservation.
- Real run: `node dist/clawsweeper.js review --local-range --base origin/main --target-repo openclaw/clawsweeper --codex-reasoning-effort low`
  - selected and reviewed one synthetic local item
  - completed with high-confidence `keep_open`
  - report: `.git/clawsweeper/reviews/local-range-1783175454520-11161/0.md`
  - checkout remained clean
- AutoReview: no actionable findings on the maintainer delta (0.79) or full branch (0.84).
- Formatting and skill frontmatter validation passed.

Original implementation by @anagnorisis2peripeteia.
